parameters.content:
## UXR Send & Stamp (Workflow C)
Inputs: batch_id, email_subject, email_body, calendly_url, test_mode.

**SAFETY SWITCH:** *Load Config* reads `liveMode` (boolean) from UXR Config. Only `true` allows real sends; false, missing or any other value forces test mode: every recipient becomes `testRecipient`, the batch is capped at `testMaxRecipients`, the subject gets a `[TEST for <real email>]` prefix, the body a header, and NOTHING is written to Customer.io. Candidate rows end as `test_sent` (not `sent`) so the batch stays reusable.

**DUPLICATE GUARD:** *Get Recently Sent* loads the Candidates table (no filter: the Data Table node dropped an OR filter silently); *Prepare Recipients* keeps rows with status `sent` or `booked` and skips (a) emails sent within `cooldownDays` (covers the lag before Customer.io segment 260 refreshes and sent-but-unstamped rows), (b) the same email twice in one batch, (c) malformed addresses. *Skip Duplicate?* routes those rows straight to *Record Result* as `skipped_duplicate`, no email.

**Live mode** (liveMode = true): per candidate, plain-text email (from/reply-to from Config), then Track API `PUT /api/v1/customers/cio_<cio_id>` with `_update: true` stamping `last_user_research_invite_date` (the n8n-prod workspace identifies by id, so email-based stamps would silently do nothing; rows without cio_id are sent but flagged). Rows end as `sent` / `failed`. Returns {success, sent, failed, skipped_duplicate, stamp_failed, details, test_mode}.

Refuses to run if the body still contains {{calendly_link}} and no calendly_url is given.
